newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria M1 rises 5.70 pct, M2 up 2.66 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria M1 rises 5.70 pct, M2 up 2.66 pct in week.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply rose to 478.3 billion levs on March 28 from 452.5 billion levs a week earlier and M2 rose to 2,986.8 billion levs from 2,909.4 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.
Total broad money increased 1.66 percent to 3,200.6 billion levs in the week to March 28.
Lev-denominated broad money rose 3.68 percent to 1,013.6 billion levs while dollar-denominated broad money edged up 0.75 percent to 2,187 billion levs. @

Hard currency-denominated deposits of companies incresed to $768.9 million on March 28 from $760.5 million on March 21, while individuals' foreign currency deposits rose by $5.8 million to $479.5 million, figures showed.
Lev-denominated deposits of individuals edged up to 81.3 billion levs on March 28 from 79.7 billion levs the week before. @
The lev eased to 1,590.8 per dollar on March 28 in the central bank fixing used in the calculations from 1,584.7 on March 21. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
